notes: Custom domains for pages: bind your own domain names to pages with per-alias redirect behavior, a new Domains admin section, DNS pre-flight checks, an admin host lock, and full SEO handling (canonicals, sitemaps, 301s). Automatic scheduled backups with keep-last-N retention and one-click restore from Settings. Custom /go/ redirect slugs that survive delete-and-recreate, and optional leading-@ page slugs for the handle style people know from other tools. The auto-generated OG share card is redesigned as a Poster Hero derived from the page theme, Settings gains an update status card with a Recheck button, the language picker becomes a compact dropdown, and self-hosters get the official omnirise/linkbreeze Docker Hub image plus a one-shot update script.
